name: OpenAQ
potential_use: Collect historical pollutant observations, identify pollution events, and expand monitoring-station coverage.
required_fields: timestamp, station_id, latitude, longitude, pollutant, value, unit
limitations: Station coverage, historical availability, sensor quality, and temporal overlap must be checked for each location.

name: India Air Quality Database - XKDR Forum
potential_use: Investigate additional Indian monitoring records and possible historical observations for comparison with OpenAQ.
limitations: Actual fields, station coverage, historical period, access conditions, and overlap with the current Indore dataset must be verified.

name: ERA5 Reanalysis
potential_use: Provide historical wind and weather fields for investigating pollution transport conditions.
limitations: Reanalysis is not a direct measurement at each factory. Spatial and temporal resolution, access requirements, and agreement with local observations must be assessed.

name: EDGAR Emissions Inventory
potential_use: Provide regional emissions context and investigate whether relevant pollutants and industrial sectors are represented.
limitations: Inventory estimates do not automatically provide actual emissions from a named factory during a specific event.

name: Published Indian PM2.5 Source Attribution Research
potential_use: Review source-attribution methodology and check for downloadable supplementary data that can support validation.
limitations: Published regional source attribution may not identify individual factories or overlap with our Indore events.

name: OpenStreetMap Industrial Facilities
potential_use: Expand and cross-check mapped industrial facility locations and available facility classifications.
limitations: Facility records can be incomplete or outdated. A mapped facility is not proof that it emitted pollution during an event.
